exact_solution_review.v15-c08-e1: Strict concavity and boundary divergence give unique global actual/planned saving. Floor max rule, three induced allocations and before-fee ranking exactly match prompt.
exact_solution_review.v15-c08-e2: Date-zero willingness, affordable actual fee and later-self loss calculated in their distinct criteria. Beta1 eliminates benefits of strictly costly commitment; no summing incompatible temporal welfare scales.
exact_solution_review.v15-c08-e3: Complete four-piece reference comparison continuous at6,10,16, with ties8,12 and strict rejection interval. Expected-money versus smooth-log observational equivalence explicit.
exact_solution_review.v15-c08-e4: General lambda/p threshold complete through endpoint beliefs and equality; extra belief/comprehension variation needed before a loss-aversion identification claim.
exact_solution_review.v15-c08-e5: Three gamma domains include continuum atonehalf; alpha remains unidentified by dictator gift. Concave altruism mimics equal giving but makes different responder predictions.
exact_solution_review.v15-c08-e6: Forced rejection at exact threshold plus continuous offers gives no best proposer choice; every accepted offer improvable and every rejected offer dominated. Finite grid restores an attained optimum.
exact_solution_review.v15-c08-e7: Expected-score square proves global truth for risk neutrality including p0/1. Correct positive expected-cash difference does not imply truthful optimal report under square-root utility.
exact_solution_review.v15-c08-e8: Independent binary prize expectation uses state-independent utility difference and adequate maximum reserve. Event-dependent gains produce exact6/7 optimum and identify failed assumption.
exact_solution_review.v15-c08-e9: Factorial cell means and inverse-probability expectation derived; trial/target composition requires stability and support. Exact independent familywise probability and general union-bound guarantee distinguished.
exact_solution_review.v15-c08-e10: Seven explicit audit criteria require rival mechanism, credible assignment, measurement, replication/transport, multiplicity, funded welfare and revision. No unique ideological answer or unperformed experiment claim.

proof_review.temporal: Three-date beta-delta model, no borrowing/trading around floor, distinct dated selves and beliefs about future beta. Strict concavity, endpoint divergence, floor corners, beta1 and fee limits proven. Date0 endowment/provider cost and later resource equations fully funded.
proof_review.reference: Final wealth menu fixed independently of reference; lambda>=1 expected piecewise value not claimed full prospect theory. Global piece branches/ties and smooth EU rival complete; escrow funds all realizations.
proof_review.social: Domain alpha>=gamma>=0,gamma<1; compact dictator problem with all argmax cases and continuous ultimatum threshold/tie dependence. Sponsor retained rejection funds counted; alternative altruism and normative distinction explicit.
proof_review.belief: Bayesian posterior computed; quadratic-score global truth under expected money, strict-concave risk-averse cash solution, independent binary-prize proof under clearly narrower state-independent EU/reduction conditions. State-dependent prize utility breaks truthfulness.
proof_review.experiment: Four-cell positive-probability consistency/HT proof, context effects versus psychological interpretation, common-estimand normal pooling assumptions, multiplicity and support/conditional-response transport. Welfare criterion and real costs are additional.

source_review: Read full accepted V05C12 references for Laibson and reference dependence; reused historical scopes with original-inspector attribution. Actual university-hosted Fehr-Schmidt PDF body text read at recorded sections/pages. Hossain-Okui attribution limited to official publisher abstract/metadata and author listing; body opens failed and linked Drive returned loading/sign-in, honestly recorded. No whole-paper, empirical, local-byte or rendered inspection claimed beyond evidence.
instruction_review: Five original cases and ten full exact solutions, complete teach-back/retention guides, all needed methods taught before prompts. Canonical C07 prerequisite and planned C09 successor route. No current policy or population behavioral estimate asserted.
numerical_review: Every nine input groups and20 output groups reconstructed from primitives; dated resource/welfare, piecewise reference boundaries, dictator/ultimatum full choice sets, scoring global optima, factorial contrast, precision-weighted variance and multiplicity verified. Alternative-primitive/global witnesses supplement complete proof reading; explicit rejection guards survive -O.
